text:
deploy-bot: Rollforward started: service=inference-api, version=v2.6, strategy=blue-green, target=eu-west (20% traffic), started by @Carlos

incident-bot: ALERT -> high-5xx-rate on apac-edge detected for inference-api (5xx rate 6.2% over 5m) :rotating_light:

Aisha: seeing the same in Grafana. Errors spike right after 10:12 UTC when rollout started. Latency also up ~300ms p50 in apac-edge.

Ravi: i'm on it. checking traces and k8s events now. planning to pull canary pods logs.

Carlos: fyi i kicked the rollout with the region flag. config used: `region_rollout: "eu-west:20"` — should be scoped, but that's what the deploy tool used.

Aisha: logs from an APAC edge pod showing model load failures: `ERROR ModelLoader - missing weights for shard 3` followed by connection resets.

Ravi: running quick curl to canary endpoint from apac worker: `curl -v https://apac-edge.example/api/v1/generate` -> 502 Bad Gateway consistently.

Carlos: that's unexpected, rollout should not affect apac. checking routing table and envoy configs.

Marta: paging oncall-sre now. @oncall-sre please join, possible cross-region routing leak.

oncall-sre: oncall-sre here. I see our traffic-shaper pushed 20% of global inference traffic to the new instances but the overlay rules used a selector that matched both `eu-west` and `apac-*` due to a broken regex in the rollout job.

Emily: can we kill the feature flag for the rollout? feature flags are `rollout_region_v2_6`. If we flip to `off` it should stop new traffic.

Carlos: doing feature flag kill now. running:
```
ffctl set rollout_region_v2_6 off --scope global --actor carlos
```

incident-bot: ACTION -> feature flag rollout_region_v2_6 set to OFF by Carlos :white_check_mark:

Ravi: after the kill, 5xxs dropped from 6.2% to 1.1% in ~35s. good sign. still seeing some residual errors from existing sessions.

Aisha: starting a rollback of the canary in eu-west to v2.5 to be safe. command: 
```
redwoodctl rollback --service inference-api --region eu-west --to-version v2.5 --force
```

Carlos: rollback initiated. I also disabled the new routing policy in the edge control plane:
```
edgectl set-route --service inference-api --region apac --weight 100 --actor carlos
edgectl set-route --service inference-api --region eu-west --weight 0 --actor carlos
```

oncall-sre: confirming BGP / DNS status — no DNS changes were pushed, this was an internal routing rule. However, we did find a race where the rollout job updated the global overlay and an older deploy hook reapplied a selector. root cause theory: rollout job intended to patch `overlay.selector.region == eu-west` but selector regex `^.*eu-west.*$` matched `apac-eu-west-proxy` hostnames in apac cluster.

Marta: customer impact quick summary: error rate peaked for ~7 minutes, estimated failed requests ~0.85% of global QPS. No data leak. A handful of enterprise customers reported 502s; CS has two ongoing tickets.

Emily: handing page to SRE rotation for long tail follow-up. @oncall-sre please take incident from here and prepare postmortem template.

oncall-sre: acknowledged. I will collect artifacts: rollout job logs, overlay diffs, feature flag flip timeline, pod logs, and canary metrics (latency/5xx). Will also open a postmortem doc and tag ENG/PL/CS.

Ravi: notes for postmortem: reproduce locally by running rollout job against a test overlay that has hostnames with `apac-eu-west-proxy` to validate regex overspill. propose: change rollout tooling to use explicit region labels instead of regex selectors, and add a dry-run validation step that simulates selector matches.

Carlos: i also propose a small safety patch: default rollout scope = region label boolean, and a preflight check that fails if selector matches more than 5 nodes.

Aisha: i've opened CS bulletin draft for affected customers with the summary and mitigation steps. tagging legal for review (no PII involved).

incident-bot: INCIDENT -> incident created #INC-2026-784 by oncall-sre, severity=SEV2, summary="rollforward leak: eu-west rollout leaked to apac via selector regex"

oncall-sre: timeline so far will go into the doc. closing the page for active mitigation; follow-ups assigned: ENG (fix selectors & preflight), SRE (improve observability of rollout diffs), CS (customer comms). If new alerts reappear re-open and ping rotation.

Marta: thanks everyone, nice quick kill and rollback.

Emily: follow-up: add a canary-runner check that verifies region isolation by sending synthetic requests from each region before flipping traffic.

Carlos: agreed. i'll ship a PR with selector change and preflight tests, target patch release tomorrow morning UTC.

Aisha: good job, closing thread for now. :white_check_mark:
